description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thalatuwa, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420352
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, and owner details) in various locations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
